title: 21:9 cinematic ratio for every video model (H3, LTX, WAN, WAN-5B)
description: Add a 21:9 cinematic (anamorphic widescreen) entry to every video ratio tier, alongside the existing 1:1 / 9:16 / 16:9. Each model gets its own table honouring its own grid constraint - H3 /32, LTX /64 (2-stage floor), WAN /16, WAN-5B /32 - and each ladder is area-incremental across tiers. Covers the 2k and 4k tiers too. H3 2k and 4k entries (all ratios, not just 21:9) additionally carry an 'Experimental - High VRAM' note in their status-bar info string.
